profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at ServiceUp | Scalable Architecture, User-Centered Design, & Cross-Platform Development | Passionate About Digital Transformation & Innovation
profile.summary:
With over 8 years of experience as a full stack software engineer, I specialize in designing scalable
architectures, modernizing legacy systems, and creating user-centered solutions that drive digital
transformation. I bring a proven track record of delivering high-quality applications across web and mobile platforms, leveraging advanced coding practices, performance optimizations, and modular frameworks to achieve measurable results.

Passionate about innovation, I thrive on solving complex technical challenges, and fostering collaboration across diverse teams. My experience spans full stack development, cross-platform migrations, observability tools, and secure application design, ensuring that every solution aligns with business goals and exceeds stakeholder expectations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
ServiceUp is an AI-powered fleet repair platform that helps fleets and repair shops manage the full repair lifecycle in one connected system. By bringing workflows, marketplace access, and data intelligence together, ServiceUp helps organizations reduce vehicle downtime, improve cost control, and operate more efficiently at scale. The platform modernizes how repair decisions are made and executed, giving customers greater visibility, faster outcomes, and more control across their operations.

• Spearheaded the replacement of a legacy native app with a React Native Shell, enabling seamless cross-platform compatibility and enhancing mobile user experiences.
• Implemented Slack webhooks to automate workflows, notifying teams of critical user-triggered actions to streamline communication and operations.
• Led the development of an intuitive insurance application, improving customer digital interactions and simplifying claims resolution.
• Revamped React components to enhance maintainability, responsiveness, and scalability, reducing technical debt and accelerating development cycles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated a legacy app into a monorepo architecture using MVVM and Next.js, improving scalability and boosting performance by 25%.
• Designed a user event tracking system that enabled actionable insights, reducing user friction and improving engagement by 10%.
• Partnered with UX designers to deliver functional and visually appealing interfaces through iterative testing and feedback.
• Reduced downtime and enhanced reliability by monitoring application performance with Datadog and AWS CloudWatch.
• Coached offshore contractors to improve productivity by 20% through tailored training strategies and collaborative approaches.

positions.title: Americas Technical - Intern
positions.description:
• Americas Technical Help Desk (THD) Lotus Notes Tool Analysis. 
• Understand existing Lotus Notes (LN) Databases used by the THD, determine content required going forward and analyze effectiveness of current tools. 
• Develop a plan to improve, replace, and retire existing LN Databases.

positions.description:
• Verification of implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions to improve processes and prevent incidents. 
• Support to QA technicians in reporting and investigating quality incidents, and performing quality testing. 
• In charge of container degradation experiment and physical tests.

positions.title: Global Strategic Planning - Intern
positions.description:
• Evaluated a number of key inputs for sustainability, including water reporting requirements, water consumption data, and competitive positioning on offerings. 
• Contributed to the improvement of the HYCO Burner Tip Temperature Model. 
• Support to Corporate Sustainability Manager with the CDP Project.
